doc: Audio contract for the AudioDirector autoload. See docs/AUDIO_BIBLE.md. Generated: do not edit; change tools/audio/*.py and re-run.

S01.name: tap
S01.event: Any touch-down: UI control (UI bus) or world object (SFX bus)
S01.visual_twin: tint +6 L*, UI scale 0.96 in 80 ms / world squash 0.94

S02.name: collect
S02.event: Collect dew / a gift (each item of Collect all)
S02.trigger: per item as it lands on the counter
S02.caption: CAPTION_COLLECT
S02.visual_twin: gifts fly to the HUD, counter rolls 600 ms

S03.name: pet_purr
S03.event: Long-press / stroke a mossling (loops while held)
S03.trigger: at 450 ms hold; loops; 150 ms release
S03.caption: CAPTION_PURR
S03.visual_twin: radial fill, squash 0.88, hearts on release

S04.name: bud_unfurl
S04.event: Tap a ready bud (600 ms unfurl)
S04.caption: CAPTION_BLOOM

S05.name: plant_place
S05.event: Plant a flower / place a decor piece (incl. tutorial seed)
S05.trigger: when the seed lands / piece settles
S05.caption: CAPTION_PLANT
S05.visual_twin: seed arc 320 ms, soil puff / piece settles 500 ms

S06.name: water
S06.caption: CAPTION_SPLASH
S06.visual_twin: ripple ring to 36 dp in 380 ms

S07.name: sheet_open
S07.trigger: as the sheet starts to rise

S11.name: not_possible
S11.event: Not affordable / not possible (never a buzz)
S11.visual_twin: price chip pulse, +-2 dp wiggle (never red)

S12.name: creature_arrive_nap
S12.event: A mossling arrives (up a fifth) / curls up to nap (down)

S13.name: creature_chirp
S13.event: Tap a mossling (it turns to you and chirps)
S13.caption: CAPTION_CHIRP
S13.visual_twin: look-at, chirp bubble, name tag 2 s

S14.name: snore
S14.event: Tap a napping mossling (it stays asleep) / idle snore
S14.caption: CAPTION_SNORE

S16.name: postcard
S16.caption: CAPTION_POSTCARD
S16.visual_twin: mailbox flag pops up, wiggles every 8 s

S17.name: leaf_boat
S17.caption: CAPTION_BOAT
S17.visual_twin: boat launches at the spring rock

S18.name: bed_rustle
S18.event: Tap a bed with no ready buds

S20.name: lantern
S20.visual_twin: lantern glow +40 % for 1.2 s, fireflies drift in

S21.name: wind_chime
S21.event: Tap the shell wind chime (falling run) / breeze gusts ring it
S21.caption: CAPTION_CHIME
